description: This header file declares functions for managing shared meter features in the RTL8367C switch driver, including setting and retrieving meter parameters such as rate, bucket size, and type, as well as checking meter exceed status.

methods.name: rtl8367c_setAsicShareMeter
methods.description: Sets the shared meter parameters for a specific index, including rate and inter-frame gap.

methods.name: rtl8367c_getAsicShareMeter
methods.description: Retrieves the current rate and inter-frame gap settings for a specific shared meter index.

methods.name: rtl8367c_setAsicShareMeterBucketSize
methods.description: Sets the bucket size threshold for a specific shared meter.

methods.name: rtl8367c_getAsicShareMeterBucketSize
methods.description: Retrieves the bucket size threshold for a specific shared meter.

methods.name: rtl8367c_setAsicShareMeterType
methods.description: Sets the type (mode) for a specific shared meter.

methods.name: rtl8367c_getAsicShareMeterType
methods.description: Retrieves the type (mode) of a specific shared meter.

methods.name: rtl8367c_setAsicMeterExceedStatus
methods.description: Sets the status indicating whether a meter has exceeded its limit for a specific index.

methods.name: rtl8367c_getAsicMeterExceedStatus
methods.description: Retrieves whether a meter at a specific index has exceeded its limit.
